title: Add a tenant-bound Space email identity registry with provider-only verification and fresh worker resolution
detail: Draft implementation: generated additive migration creates owner-readable/service-write-only domains and identities with composite tenant foreign key. Server-only owner management derives authenticated profile, requires paid capability for creation, confines registration to preassigned Space domain/subdomains and obtains verification directly from Resend; callers cannot set verified flags. Worker resolver reads current plan/capability and exact linked registry plus current provider verification before constructing From; owner may pause after downgrade. Fixture behavior tests pass. NOT complete: local SQL replay/RLS unverified because Docker socket inaccessible; production worker wiring belongs dependency integration; domain ownership challenge/provisioning wizard and defaults/reply aliases remain separate packets. Do not treat stored Space domain as independent DNS ownership proof during future onboarding. Existing paid entitlement blobs require authorized billing resolver reconciliation. No production API, SQL, DNS or emails executed.

verify.evidence: Application fixture tests: 26 tests passed across provider/registry/policy; targeted lint/diff checks. Added 11 behavioral pgTAP assertions for two-owner tenant isolation/auth-profile mapping, mutation refusal, composite FK and service-role operations. SQL test NOT RUN. Database acceptance NOT RUN: Supabase status failed Docker socket operation not permitted. Close only after migration replay and owner/nonowner/anon/service-role RLS tests, cross-Space FK rejection, fresh provider failure hold and production worker-boundary integration pass.
